name: calli
description: Run coding agents on a remote host and drive them from a browser.

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:mac -w @calli/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @calli/daemon && npm run build -w @calli/web && npm run build -w @calli/ext-loopx
scripts.test: npm test -w @calli/daemon && npm test -w @calli/web && npm test -w @calli/ext-board && npm test -w @calli/site && npm test -w @calli/ext-loopx && npm test -w @calli/desktop && npm run test:runner -w @calli/e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @calli/daemon && npm run typecheck -w @calli/web && npm run typecheck -w @calli/ext-board && npm run typecheck -w @calli/site && npm run typecheck -w @calli/ext-loopx && npm run typecheck -w @calli/ext-memory && npm run typecheck -w @calli/ext-voice && npm run typecheck -w @calli/desktop
